svg.title: UC-P06 - Check In a Private EV

g.text: UC-P06 - Check In a Private EV
Preconditions: Student is signed in, has arrived at the Hub and has a reservation reference.
Service calls use the signed-in Student's identity.
[missing, not owned, Cancelled/Expired/Completed or retrieval failed]
[invalid or unreadable context, or check-in already completed]
End this attempt; no new session or extra occupancy.
[Validate current reservation and record one check-in]
If already checked in, return the existing Active session. Otherwise create ONE Active
session with actual unrounded arrival and mark reservation Checked In together.
Account occupancy against existing holds; keep capacity for the remaining reserved interval.
Check-in does not imply charging has started.
A charging-status read error after confirmed check-in does not undo the parking session.
Smart E-Mobility Hub | Submission 2 | Parking & Private EVs
Thin rectangle: execution of a responsibility; nested rectangle: nested execution
Solid arrow: request / action | Dashed arrow: returned result
Activation ends before waiting for Student input. Read guards top to bottom.
critical: required consistency boundary; updates are all-or-none as noted
